aluminum_structure_retrieval_subtask_sa.name: Aluminum Structure Retrieval for Surface Area
aluminum_structure_retrieval_subtask_sa.description: Retrieve structure of Aluminum and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

aluminum_potential_file_subtask_sa.name: Aluminum Potential File for Surface Energy
aluminum_potential_file_subtask_sa.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtas.name: Aluminum Bulk Relaxation for Surface Energy
aluminum_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtas.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Aluminum, based on the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. As the final output, report the total energy of the relaxed structure in electronvolts (eV), and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
aluminum_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtas.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"BULK ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed BULK Structure_path": /structure/structure.dat}

aluminum_slab_energy_minimisation_subtas.name: Aluminum Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy
aluminum_slab_energy_minimisation_subtas.description: Given paths to a LAMMPS-compatible Aluminum structure file and an Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file suitable for molecular dynamics simulations, create a slab in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform a structure relaxation on the slab using the given simulation parameters, replicating the unit cell 5 times along the x, y, and z directions. As the final output, report the total energy of the relaxed slab structure in electronvolts (eV), and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
aluminum_slab_energy_minimisation_subtas.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"SLAB ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed SLAB Structure_path": /structure/structure.dat}

aluminum_subtask_sa.name: Aluminum Surface Energy Calculation
aluminum_subtask_sa.description: Given the path to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and slab structures of Aluminum, and the total energies (in electronvolts) of its relaxed bulk and slab configurations, compute the surface energy of Aluminum. Return the surface energy in eV/Å².
